transcript:
Find the D in Find Tuning, and adjust the quality of a garment.  
If you want to change the quality of the garment, you can do it in the One Piece file and adjust the quality of the camera, or drag it into the 2D or 3D window.  
Sometimes during the simulation process, the garment may become deformed.  
After improving the quality of the garment, the simulation speed will slow down, so it is not recommended to modify the 3D garment after using this function.  
Conversely,  
if you want to reduce the quality of the garment, you can review the issues that may occur during the simulation process.  
Go to the 3D toolbar and select Reduce the quality of the garment.  
A window will appear where you can adjust the quality of the garment.  
Click OK to apply the settings.  
Activate the simulation and adjust the 3D garment.  
If you have trouble using the AI writing, take this Morgan as OK.  
Again, using the PREVENT quality tools, adjust the 3D quality of the garment, then simulate again.  
Save to continue.  
Go to the ProcedureArt tab and choose Show quality.  
You can save to your project alone without any good results.  
Thank you.  
Thank you.

chunks.content: ## Adjusting Garment Quality in CLO This section explains how to modify the quality settings of a garment in CLO, covering both increasing and reducing garment quality, the impact on simulation performance, and step-by-step procedures for effective adjustments. ### Increasing Garment Quality To enhance the quality of a garment, locate the "Find the D" option in the Fine-tuning settings. You can increase the garment's quality either by adjusting it directly in the One Piece file or by dragging the garment into the 2D or 3D window for on-the-fly adjustments. **Important considerations:** - Increasing garment quality improves visual and simulation fidelity but slows down the simulation process. - After increasing quality, avoid further modifications to the 3D garment to prevent performance issues. ### Reducing Garment Quality Reducing garment quality can help identify and resolve issues during the simulation process or improve simulation speed. **Procedure to reduce quality:** 1. Go to the 3D toolbar and select the option to reduce garment quality. 2. A settings window will appear, allowing you to adjust the quality level. 3. Click "OK" to apply the changes. 4. Activate the simulation and adjust the 3D garment as needed. Reducing quality is useful for troubleshooting simulation problems or optimizing performance when high fidelity is unnecessary. ### Additional Tools and Tips - Use the "Prevent Quality" tools to manage and control the garment’s 3D quality settings effectively. - After adjustments, simulate the garment again to verify results. - Save your project regularly to preserve changes. - The "ProcedureArt" tab includes a "Show Quality" feature, which helps visualize garment quality settings within the project. --- This guide ensures users can fine-tune garment quality in CLO to balance simulation accuracy and performance efficiently.
